budgetyourtripProxy.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Paris? Hotel Prices for Paris, France | Budget Your Trip
budgetyourtripProxy.evidenceText: $201 is the average price of the 296 1-star hotels in Paris; BudgetYourTrip states hotel prices are in US Dollars before taxes. Its Paris cost page reports $356 (€306) for two people in a typical double-occupancy hotel room.
budgetyourtripProxy.referencePeriod: Search results retrieved 2026-08-01; source page uses current listing sample.
budgetyourtripProxy.reason: Source-defined class average retained as a proxy only; it is not a directly observed two-adult booking quote.
